title: Redelivered webhook, byte-identical payload
description: The same identDrv payload for driver A is delivered twice: once at atSec 70 while the trip is open, and again later as a byte-identical redelivery (same vehicle_id, name, atSec, and driver_guid, so the same normalised timestamp string per AGENT-BRIEF item 3). Must prove: the deterministic event_id collides and exactly one rosco_driver_events row exists, with exactly one assignee-audit write. Must NOT change: the redelivery must not create a second row, must not re-fire the assignee write, and must not move the assignee off A.

driver_identifications.note: byte-identical redelivery, sent after the trip has already closed; must carry the same normalised timestamp string as the first delivery or the deterministic event_id will not collide and this test proves nothing
